stats.name: World title reigns
stats.blurb: How many times they have held a world championship.

stats.name: Longest reign (days)
stats.blurb: Their longest single reign as world champion, in days.

stats.name: Debut year
stats.blurb: The year they debuted. Earlier wins — the one stat here that lower takes.

stats.name: Mic skill
stats.blurb: Our own 0-100 rating of how they work a crowd on the microphone.

stats.name: Finisher impact
stats.blurb: Our own 0-100 rating of how much a finisher ends a match.

decks.name: The Full Roster
decks.blurb: Every card in the edition. Raw, SmackDown, NXT and the Hall of Fame.

decks.name: Hall of Fame
decks.blurb: Legends only. Long reigns and early debuts — the low-debut call wins here.

decks.name: The Giants
decks.blurb: Powerhouses and main eventers. Height, weight and the finisher settle it.

decks.name: Workrate
decks.blurb: Technicians and high flyers. Smaller cards, so the mic and the impact decide.

powerplay.name: Run-In
powerplay.blurb: Win and take one extra card from every loser. Lose and give one extra.
powerplay.when: Play it with your card, on your call or your answer.
powerplay.win: Take one extra card from every wrestler you beat.

drs.name: Cash-In
drs.blurb: Overrule the call with a stat of your own. Win and you call next. Lose one extra if not.
drs.when: Only when answering someone else's call — tap the stat you cash in on.
drs.win: Your stat decides the round, and you call next.

super-over.name: Rematch Clause
super-over.blurb: Lose the round, and your next card faces the winner's next card on the same stat. Win that and you take everything they just won.
super-over.when: Play it with your card. It only fires if you lose the round — win or tie and you keep it, unspent.
super-over.win: Your next card beats theirs on the called stat: you take every card they just won, and theirs too.
super-over.fail: Your next card loses as well, and goes to them with the rest.
